_doc: Claims this repo once made, found false, and corrected. scripts/claims_check.py fails CI if one reappears in a tracked doc outside `history` — the files that quote it on purpose, as a record of the error. Correcting the source of truth is not enough: on 2026-08-10 the billing matrix was fixed and three docs kept stating the old claim in their own words for seven weeks. Each `patterns` entry is a case-insensitive regex, matched against text with line breaks, blockquote markers and bold collapsed, so a claim wrapped across lines still matches; a space in a pattern matches any run of whitespace.

claims.retracted: Anthropic's move of headless claude -p to a metered Agent SDK credit was cancelled before it took effect, so a subscription still covers unattended volume.
claims.truth: It took effect on 2026-06-15: claude -p draws on a capped monthly Agent SDK credit, not plan usage limits.

claims.retracted: Mem0 removed/deleted its own graph after its benchmarks showed the graph lost on single- and multi-hop recall.
claims.truth: Mem0 replaced its external graph-DB integration with a native, always-on built-in graph. Its paper found the graph ~2% better overall: best on temporal, better on open-domain, a marginal drop on single-hop, no gain on multi-hop.
